name: Immuneering Corporation
summary: Immuneering Corporation, a late-stage oncology company, develops medicines for broad populations of cancer patients in the United States. The company develops IMM-1-104 (atebimetinib), a dual-MEK inhibitor that is in a Phase 3 clinical trial to treat patients with cancer, including pancreatic and non-small cell lung cancer caused by mutations of RAS or RAF; IMM-6-415 (envometinib), which is in Phase 1/2a clinical trial for the treatment of patients with solid tumors; and multiple deep cyclic inhibitor discovery programs.
